system.description:
You lead your allies to capitalize on a brief moment where the enemy is left completely open. To cast this jutsu you must have at least 1 ally within 30 feet who can cast a C-Rank or lower Taijutsu or Bukijutsu as 1 Action.

All willing allies can spend their reaction as part of this jutsu’s casting.

First, you make a melee Taijutsu attack against the target creature, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 6d8 on a hit and if the affected creature has Jutsu based damage reduction, your attack gains a +2 to its critical threat range.

Next, each allied creature in whatever order they decide spends their reaction to cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu they know with a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the same creature you targeted with your attack. If the affected creature has Jutsu based damage reduction, their attack gains a +1 to their critical threat range.

Chain 2: Defense is part of a good offense. Yourself, and all allied creatures who case jutsu as part of this jutsu’s effect gain 8 temporary hit points until the end of your next turn.
